parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description:
The data center. This value must be the same as the data center that you specified when you called [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~).

> The supported data centers are China (Shanghai) (cn-shanghai) and Singapore (ap-southeast-1).

parameters.name: ExceptUsers
parameters.description: The users who are exempt from the group-wide mute. Specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,).
